scientific_integrity: Uniform algebraic proof included; standalone direct checks cover specified small prime-field cases. Originality is assessed against identified literature, not certified universally. No external or independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem concerns only unital, scalar-preserving, pairwise-commuting algebra retractions of cubically truncated free associative algebras over finite fields. It does not classify arbitrary endomorphisms, noncommuting families, or higher truncation degrees. Finite exact checks are not proofs of the uniform formula.
title: Exact tensor-resonance census for commuting algebra retractions
